summary: Built laboratory and bioinformatics capability for commercial and national genomics programmes.
achievements: Established Illumina sequencing capability and integrated laboratory, analysis and scientific leadership.
Supported MyGenome, microbial and biodiversity programmes including the Proboscis Monkey genome.
Developed staff capability and robust analysis pipelines for human genome delivery and interpretation.

title: Postdoctoral Researcher
summary: Developed comparative-genomics resources, annotation systems and molecular-marker methods.
achievements: Contributed to annotation of the first Arabidopsis genome and built Sputnik, a comparative plant-genomics platform covering millions of expressed sequences.
Connected genome annotation, comparative analysis and marker discovery in tools designed for working plant biologists.

title: Founder / Genomics Consultant
summary: Provided independent genomics, bioinformatics and scientific software advice.
achievements: Helped organisations frame analysis problems, delivery models and technology choices.

title: Senior Specialist, Bioinformatics
summary: Applied computational biology to discovery research and strengthened bioinformatics practice within pharmaceutical R&D.
achievements: Developed translational analysis approaches for gene expression, toxicogenomics and pharmacogenomics.
Supervised research and helped scientists use reproducible computational methods in decision-making.

title: Director, Bioinformatics Product
summary: Advanced through four appointments to lead the customer-led bioinformatics roadmap for EPI2ME, connecting scientific applications, commercial insight and software delivery.
achievements: Set EPI2ME product direction around accessible, reproducible nanopore analysis and Nextflow-based workflow orchestration.
Established a voice-of-customer loop across customers, applications scientists, commercial teams and engineers, translating field evidence into roadmap choices.
Shaped cloud and on-device workflow strategy, including the rapid bioinformatics response to COVID-19 sequencing needs.
Made capability building part of product adoption through training, technical communication and approachable user journeys for complex computational tasks.

title: Territory Manager
summary: Enabled long-read sequencing adoption across India, South-East Asia, Australia and New Zealand.
achievements: Combined technical support, commercial leadership and voice-of-customer insight across a diverse international territory.

title: Head of Computational Biology
summary: Led commercial bioinformatics services, scientific consultancy and customer delivery.
achievements: Developed internal tooling and repeatable delivery practices that helped turn expert analyses into scalable services.
Built customer confidence by connecting experimental context, computational design and decision-ready reporting.

title: Senior Scientist / Head of Bioinformatics / Visiting Scientist
summary: Established and led the bioinformatics core facility and research capability within the Turku Centre for Biotechnology, a department of the University of Turku.
achievements: Built workflows for Affymetrix, Illumina and Agilent platforms with a semi-automatic reporting framework.
Led research and service delivery across clinical genomics, plant genomics, endometriosis and mouse myelination.
Developed researchers through training, supervision and embedded project collaboration.

title: Nextflow and nanopores: democratising the analysis of long-read DNA sequences
Bacterial genomics: from biology to publication

description: International customer enablement for nanopore analysis, including Bioinformatics 101 and the Nextflow Summit.
Scientific workshops spanning long-read sequencing, bacterial genomics and reproducible workflow adoption.
